about.title: About Rewards Calculator - Credit Card Points and Cashback Tool
about.description: The Rewards Calculator is a comprehensive credit card optimization tool designed to help you maximize earnings from credit card rewards programs including cashback, points, and miles. This calculator analyzes spending patterns across different categories to determine optimal card usage and annual rewards potential. Whether you're comparing credit cards or optimizing existing rewards, this tool provides detailed analysis of rewards earnings and redemption values.

faq.q: How do I maximize credit card rewards?
faq.a: Maximize rewards by using cards with highest rates for your top spending categories, meeting welcome bonus requirements, taking advantage of rotating categories, and choosing optimal redemption methods for points and miles.

faq.q: Are annual fee cards worth it?
faq.a: Annual fee cards can be worth it if the additional rewards, benefits, and welcome bonuses exceed the fee cost. Calculate your annual rewards potential minus the fee to determine net value.

faq.q: What's the best way to redeem credit card points?
faq.a: Redemption value varies by program. Travel redemptions often provide 1.2-2+ cents per point, while cash back is typically 1 cent per point. Statement credits and gift cards usually offer lower values.

faq.q: Should I use multiple rewards credit cards?
faq.a: Using multiple cards can maximize rewards if you can manage them responsibly. Use different cards for their strongest categories (e.g., one for dining, another for gas) while avoiding overspending or missing payments.
